chunks: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I said to Al-Rida (peace be upon him): 'Does a man marry the woman who accepted him?' He said, 'Glory be to Allah, Allah did not forbid him from that.'

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Al-Rida (Imam Musa ibn Ja'far), the 7th Imam
key_terms.سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ: Glory be to Allah (an expression of affirmation or wonder)
key_terms.قَبِلَتْهُ: She accepted him (the proposal of marriage)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a man to marry a woman who accepted his proposal?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Rida (peace be upon him) clarifies that the mere acceptance of a marriage proposal by a woman does not constitute a Sharia impediment, affirming the general permissibility of the union. This ruling underscores the principle that unless a specific textual prohibition exists, marital contracts remain valid upon mutual consent, a key tenet in Shia jurisprudence regarding the conditions of *nikah*.
